label: Copy phase of very short (L=3, some L=4) sequences, near the final outputs
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or on <DEL>), and only on re-fed inputs that are not first occurrences, mostly on the last two copy steps (to_go 0-1 hold 92% of mass). Strongly concentrated on L=3 sequences (25% active rate, 55% of mass; L=3 copy steps are active 75% of the time, the t=5 step 91%). The strongest activations are the last copy step of L=3 sequences, especially when the re-fed input is d, w or v (e.g. "1 d v <DEL> 1 [d]"). In longer sequences it fires weakly and sparsely near the end of the copy, boosted when the input is d/w/m/y; this tail (about 30% of mass) is not well captured. Does not fire on original-phase steps, the delimiter, or early copy steps of long sequences.
